description: Proofline: show approved decisions before an edit and enforce their Enforce: rules after it. Silent unless the project has a .proofline/proofline.db and the proofline CLI is installed.

hooks.command: command -v proofline >/dev/null 2>&1 && proofline agent-hook pre || true
command -v proofline >/dev/null 2>&1 && proofline agent-hook post || true
